fields.name: vptr
fields.evidence: Constructor inlined in the fighter boma builder (around 0x7100689af0) stores vptr 0x7104f883e8 and the boma, then the object goes to boma+0x118.

fields.name: owner_boma
fields.evidence: Stored with the vptr by the constructor; reset_area reads AreaModule through [+0x8]+0xC0, the per-frame pass reads StatusModule ([+0x8]+0x40), KineticModule (+0x68) and SlowModule (+0x170).

fields.name: jostle_area
fields.evidence: reset_area (+0xF8, f_7100478b40) asks AreaModule (boma+0xC0) whether area kind (+0x70) exists (virtual +0x110), then stores the area got from virtual +0x118 here, else null. The per-frame pass (f_7100478500) reads its +0x24 and +0x21 bytes (area enabled) before registering in the jostle manager; the address of this field is the node payload of the manager's lists. Reset (+0x38) recomputes it.

fields.name: jostle_param
fields.evidence: init (+0x28, f_7100477e70) copies the u64 at init-data +0x300; slot +0xD8 (f_7100478b00) overwrites it. The per-frame pass reads two floats at its +0x10 (z step per frame) and +0x14 (z limit) to move pos_z.

fields.name: jostle_speed_x
fields.how: computed: 0 when fix (+0x74) or ignore_speed_x (+0x77) is set, else plain load
fields.evidence: jostle_speed_x slot (+0x80, f_71004789c0). Zeroed each frame by the per-frame pass and by reset; the value is written by the jostle manager's pair resolution (not located).

fields.name: push_speed_x
fields.evidence: set_push_speed_x (export calls vtable +0xB8 = f_7100478aa0) writes the float into +0x24 and +0x28 and the bool into +0x78; set_push_speed_x_2 (+0xC0, f_7100478ac0) writes p[0] here and p[1] at +0x28.

fields.name: push_speed_x_2
fields.evidence: Second value of set_push_speed_x_2 (a two-float array); set_push_speed_x writes the same value as +0x24 (probably one value per jostle side/direction).

fields.name: pos_z
fields.how: computed: 0 when fix (+0x74), else plain load
fields.evidence: pos_z slot (+0xA8, f_7100478a70). Per-frame pass: gap (force_gap, 0 meaning MIDDLE) BACK moves it toward -limit, FRONT toward +limit, MIDDLE back toward 0, by the step at jostle_param+0x10.

fields.name: overlap_x
fields.how: computed: 0 when fix or ignore_speed_x; else +0x30, times +0x34 when the bool is true
fields.evidence: overlap_x export calls vtable +0x100 = f_7100478bc0. Zeroed every frame; written by the manager's pair resolution.

fields.name: overlap_rate
fields.evidence: Multiplier of overlap_x(true); set to 1.0 by constructor, reset and each frame, otherwise written by the manager.

fields.name: push_speed_x_overlap_rate
fields.evidence: set_push_speed_x_overlap_rate (+0x110, f_7100478c00) stores it; set_push_speed_x_overlap_rate_status (+0x118, f_7100478c10) stores it and sets +0x7A so the status-end hook (+0x168) restores 1.0. Init 1.0.

fields.name: ignore_owner_id
fields.evidence: ignore_owner_id slot (+0xF0, f_7100478b30) loads it; set_ignore_owner_id (+0xE8, f_7100478b20) stores it. Init/reset 0x50000000 (no object).

fields.name: contact_state
fields.evidence: Set to 0xFFFF by constructor, reset and each frame by the per-frame pass; written by the manager (not located).

fields.name: priority
fields.evidence: priority slot (+0xD0, f_7100478af0) loads the signed byte; set_priority (+0xC8) stores it; init copies init-data +0x2FC. JOSTLE_PRI_* constants (0 lowest .. 9 high).

fields.name: gap
fields.how: computed: 1 or 3 by the parity of the manager's registration counter
fields.evidence: Per-frame pass sets 1 (JOSTLE_GAP_BACK) or 3 (JOSTLE_GAP_FRONT) alternately as objects register in the manager. Constructor 2 (MIDDLE).

fields.name: force_gap
fields.evidence: set_force_gap (+0xE0, f_7100478b10) stores it; the per-frame pass treats 0 as JOSTLE_GAP_MIDDLE and steers pos_z by it (1 BACK, 2 MIDDLE, 3 FRONT).

fields.name: jostle_kind
fields.evidence: Per-frame pass: situation AIR(2) or 3 gives 1 (JOSTLE_KIND_AIR), CLIFF(1) gives 2 (JOSTLE_KIND_CLIFF), else 0 (GROUND); OUTFIELD(5) skips the pass. Also the layer used when layer is -1. Constructor 0xFF.

fields.name: ignore_pri
fields.evidence: set_ignore_pri (+0x108, f_7100478bf0) stores it; constructor/reset 10 (above JOSTLE_PRI_HIGH = 9, i.e. ignore nothing).

fields.name: team
fields.evidence: set_team (+0x160, f_7100478ca0) stores it; constructor -1.

fields.name: propagate_push_speed
fields.how: computed: KineticModule virtual +0xC8(1) x SlowModule virtual +0xA8 x +0x7C
fields.evidence: Per-frame pass writes it when propagate_push_speed (+0x79) is set: own speed (KineticModule query) times slow rate times push_speed_mul.

fields.name: received_push_speed
fields.how: computed: 0 when fix or ignore_speed_x, else plain load
fields.evidence: Unexported getter at +0x90 (f_7100478a10); zeroed each frame; written by the manager.

fields.name: speed_attenuation_rate
fields.how: computed: 0 when fix or ignore_speed_x, else plain load
fields.evidence: speed_attenuation_rate slot (+0x98, f_7100478a30); zeroed each frame; written by the manager.

fields.name: target_weight
fields.how: computed: 0 when fix or ignore_speed_x, else plain load
fields.evidence: target_weight slot (+0xA0, f_7100478a50); zeroed each frame; written by the manager.

fields.name: jostle_speed_part_a
fields.evidence: Unexported getter +0x88 (f_71004789e0) returns +0x5C + +0x60 (0 when fix/ignore_speed_x); zeroed each frame.

fields.name: jostle_speed_part_b
fields.evidence: Second term of the +0x88 sum; zeroed each frame.

fields.name: weight
fields.evidence: weight slot (+0x128, f_7100478c30) loads it; set_weight (+0x130) stores it; init copies init-data +0x308; constructor 1.0.

fields.name: influence_opponent_weight
fields.evidence: set_influence_opponent_weight (+0x138) stores arg&1; init copies init-data +0x30D.

fields.name: flag_69
fields.evidence: Unexported +0x150 (f_7100478c80) sets it to 1; constructor 0.

fields.name: overlap_rate_mul
fields.evidence: set_overlap_rate_mul (+0x158, f_7100478c90) stores it; constructor 1.0.

fields.name: area_kind
fields.evidence: area_kind slot (+0x120, f_7100478c20) loads it; init copies init-data +0x2F8; reset_area uses it to look the area up in AreaModule.

fields.name: layer
fields.evidence: set_layer (+0x50, f_71004784b0) stores it; reset 0xFF (-1 = use jostle_kind). The per-frame pass picks the manager list by it (5 = JOSTLE_LAYER_ALL handled apart).

fields.name: status
fields.evidence: set_status (export calls +0x48 = f_71004784a0) stores arg&1; the per-frame pass registers in the manager only when set. Reset clears it.

fields.name: fix
fields.evidence: set_fix (export calls +0x58 = f_71004784c0) stores it; every speed/overlap/pos_z getter returns 0 when set.

fields.name: refer
fields.evidence: set_refer (export calls +0xB0 = f_7100478a90) stores it; the per-frame pass puts the area in the manager's 'refer' list (+0x60) instead of the main list.

fields.name: is_sleep
fields.evidence: is_sleep slot (+0x70, f_71004784f0) loads it; sleep (export calls +0x68 = f_71004784e0) stores arg&1; the per-frame pass does nothing while set; reset clears it.

fields.name: ignore_speed_x
fields.evidence: set_ignore_speed_x (export calls +0x60 = f_71004784d0) stores it; speed getters and overlap_x return 0 when set.

fields.name: push_speed_x_set
fields.evidence: Bool arg of set_push_speed_x / set_push_speed_x_2; the status-end hook (+0x168, f_7100478cb0) clears push speed (set_push_speed_x(0,false)) and resets the overlap rate to 1.0 when it was set.

fields.name: propagate_push_speed
fields.evidence: set_propagate_push_speed (export calls +0x140 = f_7100478c60); init copies init-data +0x30C; reset sets 1. When set the per-frame pass computes +0x4C and adds the area to the manager's third list (+0xC0).

fields.name: overlap_rate_status
fields.evidence: Set by set_push_speed_x_overlap_rate_status; the status-end hook then restores the rate to 1.0 and clears it.

fields.name: push_speed_mul
fields.evidence: Unexported setter +0x148 (f_7100478c70); multiplies propagate_push_speed (+0x4C); constructor 1.0.

pointers.to: jostle parameter block (f32 z step at +0x10, f32 z limit at +0x14)

notes: Single class (128 bytes). The per-frame pass f_7100478500 (non-virtual) clears the outputs (+0x20, +0x30, +0x50..+0x60, +0x40) and registers the area into the global jostle manager (singleton at 0x71052B8800, three lists at +0x00, +0x60, +0xC0, counter +0x120); the manager's pair resolution, not located, writes jostle_speed_x, overlap_x, overlap_rate, +0x50..+0x60 and +0x40. Slot +0x40 (f_7100478340) removes the area from the manager lists. Init (+0x28) reads an init-data block at +0x2F8 (area kind), +0x2FC (priority), +0x300 (param ptr), +0x308 (weight), +0x30C/+0x30D (propagate, influence flags). The getters return 0 when fix or ignore_speed_x is set, so they are 'probable' rather than plain loads.
